description: Search products or suppliers, browse a category, or scrape product/supplier URLs from Made-in-China.com.

auditedSupplierOnly.description: Only return listings whose supplier carries an 'Audited Supplier' badge from an independent inspection agency.
auditedSupplierOnly.title: Audited suppliers only

businessType.description: Only return suppliers of this business type. Leave blank for no filter. Used by product and supplier search modes.
businessType.title: Filter by business type

categoryPaths.description: Made-in-China.com catalog paths (or full catalog URLs) to browse in 'Browse a product category' mode, e.g. 'Agriculture-Food-Catalog/Beverage'.
categoryPaths.title: Category paths

certification.description: Only return products from suppliers who advertise this quality or safety certification. Leave blank for no filter.
certification.title: Filter by certification

goldSupplierOnly.description: Only return listings from suppliers with a Gold Member, Diamond Member, or higher paid membership badge.
goldSupplierOnly.title: Gold/Diamond suppliers only

includeContactDetails.description: Open the public contact page in supplier modes to add contact person, position, postal code, and showroom URL. Phone and email are not public.
includeContactDetails.title: Fetch supplier contact pages

includeProductDetails.description: Open each product page to add description, specifications, price tiers, images, video, categories, FAQ, and deeper supplier data. Adds one request per product.
includeProductDetails.title: Fetch product detail pages

includeSupplierProfile.description: Open supplier storefront and company-profile pages to add firmographics, trade terms, audit report, product groups, and verification data. Adds requests per supplier.
includeSupplierProfile.title: Fetch supplier profiles

leadingFactoryOnly.description: Only return listings whose supplier holds an 'Industry-leading Audited Factory' badge.
leadingFactoryOnly.title: Leading factories only

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return across all keywords, categories, or URLs.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxMinOrder.description: Only return products whose Minimum Order Quantity is at or below this number. Leave blank for no filter.
maxMinOrder.title: Maximum minimum-order quantity

maxPagesPerQuery.description: Maximum listing pages to walk for each keyword, category, or supplier catalog. Each page holds about 24-30 records.
maxPagesPerQuery.title: Max pages per query

priceMax.description: Only return products whose listed price is at or below this USD value. Must be used together with the minimum; a lone bound is ignored.
priceMax.title: Price range — maximum (USD)

priceMin.description: Only return products whose listed price is at or above this USD value. Must be used together with the maximum; a lone bound is ignored.
priceMin.title: Price range — minimum (USD)

productUrls.description: Product page URLs or product IDs to scrape in 'Scrape these product URLs/IDs' mode. A bare ID is resolved through the site's own search.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs

province.description: Only return listings whose supplier is located in this Chinese province, municipality, or region. Leave blank for no filter.
province.title: Filter by province

rdCapacity.description: Only return products from suppliers with this R&D or production capability. Leave blank for no filter.
rdCapacity.title: Filter by R&D/production capability

sampleAvailableOnly.description: Only return products whose supplier offers a paid sample order ('Buy Sample').
sampleAvailableOnly.title: Sample available only

searchQueries.description: One or more product or supplier keywords. Used by 'Search products' and 'Find suppliers' modes (e.g. 'industrial pump', 'LED lights').
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

securedTradingOnly.description: Only return listings that offer Secured Trading (payment protection and after-sales support through Made-in-China.com).
securedTradingOnly.title: Secured Trading listings only

supplierUrls.description: Supplier storefront URLs or subdomains, e.g. 'allslorm.en.made-in-china.com' or just 'allslorm'. Used by 'Scrape these supplier storefronts' and 'Scrape a supplier's catalog'.
supplierUrls.title: Supplier URLs or subdomains

title: Made-in-China Scraper Input
